name: linkage_of_common_neighbor_right
lines: hdir : D.Adj s₂ v ∧ D.Adj v t₂ ∨ D.Adj t₂ v ∧ D.Adj v s₂
(digraph_is_directed_path D p₁ s₁ t₁ ∨ digraph_is_directed_path D p₁ t₁ s₁) ∧
(digraph_is_directed_path D p₂ s₂ t₂ ∨ digraph_is_directed_path D p₂ t₂ s₂) ∧ p₁.Disjoint p₂
s₁ t₁ s₂ t₂ v : V
hnodup : ¬(s₁ = t₁ ∨ s₁ = s₂ ∨ s₁ = t₂) ∧ ¬(t₁ = s₂ ∨ t₁ = t₂) ∧ ¬s₂ = t₂ ∧ ¬False
⊢ ¬(s₂ = t₂ ∨ s₂ = s₁ ∨ s₂ = t₁) ∧ ¬(t₂ = s₁ ∨ t₂ = t₁) ∧ ¬s₁ = t₁ ∧ ¬False
hv : ¬(v = s₁ ∨ v = t₁ ∨ v = s₂ ∨ v = t₂ ∨ False)
⊢ ¬(v = s₂ ∨ v = t₂ ∨ v = s₁ ∨ v = t₁ ∨ False)
h₁ : digraph_is_directed_path D p₁ s₂ t₂ ∨ digraph_is_directed_path D p₁ t₂ s₂
h₂ : digraph_is_directed_path D p₂ s₁ t₁ ∨ digraph_is_directed_path D p₂ t₁ s₁

steps.tactic:
have hnodup' : [s₂, t₂, s₁, t₁].Nodup :=
  by
  simp only [List.nodup_cons, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, List.nodup_nil, and_true] at hnodup ⊢
  tauto
simp only [List.nodup_cons, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, List.nodup_nil, and_true] at hnodup ⊢

have hv' : v ∉ [s₂, t₂, s₁, t₁] :=
  by
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil] at hv ⊢
  tauto
obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, ⟨h₁, h₂, hd⟩⟩ := linkage_of_common_neighbor D hstrong hnodup' v hv' hdir
